title: idev delegation return
description: What a subagent reports back. The old protocol was free text parsed by regex (review §3.7); this is the structured form. The field names match the report lines in agents/*.md so a person reading either sees the same words.

status.description: BLOCKED carries whose fault it is: brief means the conductor must re-brief, env means the product checkout, logic means a person has to decide, domain means another executor's domain and the conductor consults that role once.

assumed.description: What was taken on faith. '无' is a valid answer and has to be written: silence is not the same as nothing. Anything else starts with [承重] (the conclusion falls if it is wrong, so a person decides before the step can PASS) or [非承重].

scope.description: What the agent intended to change, decided before touching anything.

revert.description: How to undo this. Required once anything changed, because a change nobody can revert is not a reviewable change.

signoff_writes.description: Signature fields this agent claims to have written. Must be empty: agents do not sign. A non-empty value stops the run.

facts.description: Where the judgement came from. First-hand sources only; 'the document says' is circular for the agents that write documents.

red_first.description: The failing run that proves the fix fixes something. Required for review.fix.

unproven_reasons.description: Counted, not scored. The kernel reports why a dimension is unproven and leaves the judgement to a person.

guide.description: A domain constraint another role must keep, plus an evidence path. Empty means none. The conductor copies it; it does not stop the run.

domain.description: Set with BLOCKED(domain): which of the five executors owns the stuck question.

parsed_from.description: Set to legacy-regex when this was recovered from free text, so the weekly audit can count how often the old path is still used.

allOf.description: A PASS with no evidence does not count. This is the oldest rule in the kernel.
Anything changed needs a revert anchor.
A verification report says which dimension it ran.
